title: agentproto workstation e2b template — canonical pin declaration
description: Single source of truth for the versions baked into the agentproto-workstation e2b template and surfaced via scripts/sync-templates.mjs. Hand-edit this file, then run `node scripts/sync-templates.mjs` to regenerate the derived files.

baseImage.description: Base image the workstation Dockerfile builds FROM (ARG BASE_IMAGE).

cli.description: Pinned @agentproto/cli version baked into the template.

adapters.description: Adapter packages baked into the template, at exact pins.

runtime.description: Agent runtime CLIs baked into the template (e.g. opencode-ai), at exact pins.

id.description: The published e2b template id (opaque). null when not yet published.

baked.description: What the published image was PROVEN to contain at its last real e2b build. null = unknown / out-of-band bake — consumers must assume the image does NOT match the declared pins.

cli.description: The @agentproto/cli version actually verified inside the published image.

adapters.description: Adapter package -> version actually verified inside the published image.

builtAt.description: When the published image was built (ISO 8601).
